sentences.text:

Mr. Bharat Raichandani h/f Ubr Legal Advocates, Advocate for the
Petitioner
Mr. P. K. Lakhotiya, App for Respondent-State
Mr. Munde Suresh Walmikrao, Advocate for Respondent Nos.1 & 2
 ....
 Coram : Sandipkumar C. More And
 Abasaheb D. Shinde, Jj.
Dated : 09/01/2026 P. C. :
1.
Though learned APP argued by referring to the report of the concerned laboratory in respect of the seized goods, the same has not been uploaded on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to file a hard copy of the petition on record.
Similarly, learned APP assures to place on record a hard copy of the affidavit in reply along with annexures.
2. In view of the above, the matter is stood over to 17/01/2026.
3. In the meantime, learned APP undertakes to carry out further enquiry with M/s Aryan Traders and M/s A. J. Enterprises regarding the purpose for which they purchased the goods from the petitioner.

( ABASAHEB D. SHINDE, J. ) ( SANDIPKUMAR C. MORE, J. ) VS Maind/-
